+++ b/metrics.go
@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+package chi
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"net/http"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// MetricsCollector receives one RecordHit call for every request that a Mux
+// routed to a handler, after that handler (and the inline middlewares of its
+// route) returned. Install one with Mux.SetMetricsCollector.
+//
+// RecordHit runs on the goroutine that serves the request, so an
+// implementation must be safe for concurrent use and should return quickly.
+// The context is the request's, so it still carries the routing Context:
+// RouteContext(ctx) gives the matched route pattern and the URL parameters.
+type MetricsCollector interface {
+	RecordHit(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request, duration time.Duration)
+}
+
+// RouteMetric describes one request that was routed to a handler.
+type RouteMetric struct {
+	// Pattern is the matched route pattern, joined across mounted
+	// subrouters, e.g. "/users/{id}".
+	Pattern string
+
+	// Method and Path are the request's HTTP method and URL path.
+	Method string
+	Path   string
+
+	// Duration is how long the handler took to serve the request.
+	Duration time.Duration
+
+	// Params are the URL parameters of the matched route keyed by name,
+	// e.g. {"id": "123"}. It is never nil, and it is the callee's to keep.
+	Params map[string]string
+}
+
+// SimpleMetricsCollector is a MetricsCollector that turns each hit into a
+// RouteMetric and hands it to OnHit. A nil OnHit makes it do nothing.
+//
+// OnHit is called for requests served concurrently, so it must be safe for
+// concurrent use.
+type SimpleMetricsCollector struct {
+	OnHit func(RouteMetric)
+}
+
+var _ MetricsCollector = (*SimpleMetricsCollector)(nil)
+
+// RecordHit builds the RouteMetric of the request from its routing context and
+// passes it to OnHit.
+func (c *SimpleMetricsCollector) RecordHit(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request, duration time.Duration) {
+	if c == nil || c.OnHit == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	metric := RouteMetric{
+		Method:   r.Method,
+		Duration: duration,
+		Params:   map[string]string{},
+	}
+	if r.URL != nil {
+		metric.Path = r.URL.Path
+	}
+
+	if rctx := RouteContext(ctx); rctx != nil {
+		metric.Pattern = rctx.RoutePattern()
+		metric.Params = urlParamsMap(rctx)
+	}
+
+	c.OnHit(metric)
+}
+
+// urlParamsMap copies the URL parameters of rctx into a map. When a name
+// occurs more than once, for example along a stack of subrouters, the value
+// captured last wins, as it does in Context.URLParam.
+func urlParamsMap(rctx *Context) map[string]string {
+	keys, values := rctx.URLParams.Keys, rctx.URLParams.Values
+	params := make(map[string]string, len(keys))
+	for i, key := range keys {
+		if i >= len(values) {
+			break
+		}
+		params[key] = values[i]
+	}
+	return params
+}

 	// Controls the behaviour of middleware chain generation when a mux

 	inline bool

+	// Optional collector of route hit metrics, see SetMetricsCollector
+	metricsCollector MetricsCollector
 }
 
 // NewMux returns a newly initialized Mux object that implements the Router
@@ -104,6 +108,20 @@ func (mx *Mux) Use(middlewares ...func(http.Handler) http.Handler) {
 	mx.middlewares = append(mx.middlewares, middlewares...)
 }
 
+// SetMetricsCollector installs a collector that is told about every request this
+// Mux routes to a handler, with the time the handler took. Passing nil turns
+// the monitoring off, and without a collector routing does no timing at all.
+//
+// A collector belongs to the Mux it is set on: subrouters mounted on it are
+// timed as part of the request that reaches them, so the parent's collector
+// sees one hit per request, with the route pattern joined across subrouters.
+//
+// It is not safe to call SetMetricsCollector while the Mux is serving requests;
+// set it up with the routes.
+func (mx *Mux) SetMetricsCollector(collector MetricsCollector) {
+	mx.metricsCollector = collector
+}
+
 // Handle adds the route `pattern` that matches any http method to
 // execute the `handler` http.Handler.
 func (mx *Mux) Handle(pattern string, handler http.Handler) {
@@ -454,7 +472,17 @@ func (mx *Mux) routeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
 
 	// Find the route
 	if _, _, h := mx.tree.FindRoute(rctx, method, routePath); h != nil {
+		if supportsPathValue {
+			setPathValue(rctx, r)
+		}
+
+		if mx.metricsCollector == nil {
+			h.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+			return
+		}
+		start := time.Now()
 		h.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+		mx.metricsCollector.RecordHit(r.Context(), r, time.Since(start))
 		return
 	}
